records.Desc: The platform consists of multiple layers, and each tile disappears 1 second after being stepped on. Players who fall off are eliminated for that round. If any player is still standing when the countdown ends, the team wins the challenge.
Some tiles disappear when stepped on. Players who fall off return to the starting point. If at least 1 player reaches the finish line before the countdown ends, the team wins the challenge.
躲避飙速嘎嘎的冲撞。飙速嘎嘎的数量会随时间增加！从平台跌落会暂时出局10秒。倒计时结束后，若场上仍有玩家，则本轮团队挑战成功。
躲避从天而降的河豚爆弹。攻势会随时间增强！从平台跌落会暂时出局10秒。倒计时结束后，若场上仍有玩家，则本轮团队挑战成功。
Race with other players on the <color=#F0C777>night circuit through Downtown</color>. Complete the required number of laps and <color=#F0C777>cross the finish line first</color> to win.

Before the race, select a vehicle in the lobby. Different vehicles have different <color=#F0C777>Acceleration</color> and <color=#F0C777>Handling</color> stats.
Upgrade your <color=#F0C777>Racing Talent</color> to enhance your driving performance.
Race with other players on the <color=#F0C777>Neon Spiral circuit through the Chaos Space</color>. Complete the required number of laps and <color=#F0C777>cross the finish line first</color> to win.

Before the race, select a vehicle in the lobby. Different vehicles have different <color=#F0C777>Acceleration</color> and <color=#F0C777>Handling</color> stats.
Upgrade your <color=#F0C777>Racing Talent</color> to enhance your driving performance.

Take part in Saturn Entertainment’s ultimate variety show! <color=#F0C777>4 to 10</color> players work together to tackle an assortment of random stages.
The more rounds you survive, the <color=#F0C777>richer the rewards</color>. If you and your teammates hold on to the very end, you can claim the ultimate prize!

前往球场发起对局，与对手进行<color=#F0C777>1v1篮球对决</color>，率先获得11分的玩家获胜。
升级<color=#F0C777>篮球天赋</color>可强化球场表现。
Go up against another player in a darts match. Choose one of the two game modes that suits your style and outscore your opponent.

<color=#F0C777>High Score Mode</color>: Players take turns throwing darts. Hitting the bullseye, inner ring, or outer ring earns you different points. The player with the higher score at the end of all the rounds wins.
<color=#F0C777>01 Mode</color>: Both players start with a fixed score and take turns throwing darts to reduce it. The first player to <color=#F0C777>reduce their score to exactly 0</color> wins. Scoring lower than zero is invalid and requires a rethrow.

Step up to the lane and challenge another player! Control the <color=#F0C777>angle</color> and <color=#F0C777>power</color> of your throw to knock down pins and score points. The player with the highest total score after multiple rounds wins.

Take turns with your opponent placing pieces on the board. Be the first to connect <color=#F0C777>5</color> consecutive pieces of the same color in a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal direction.
Available in <color=#F0C777>Standard Mode</color> and <color=#F0C777>Skill Mode</color>. In Skill Mode, use a variety of Skills to disrupt your opponent’s moves.

<color=#F0C777>4</color> players sit around the table, taking turns drawing and discarding tiles. Use actions like <color=#F0C777>Pong</color> and <color=#F0C777>Kong</color> to build your hand and achieve a Win.
Different winning hands net different points. <color=#F0C777>Higher Fan means richer rewards</color>.

Public Events are multiplayer cooperative gameplay events that <color=#F0C777>appear on a set schedule</color> throughout the world. When an event begins, an event marker appears in the corresponding area. Head to that area to join in.

When entering as a team, idle teammates automatically receive a <color=#F0C777>participation invite</color>. If teammates are already in an event, you will be prioritized when joining their channel. 
The city features various types of Public Events, each with unique <color=#F0C777>Gameplay Objectives</color> and <color=#F0C777>Challenge Objectives</color>.

The gallery has been seized by Chaos, and countless artworks have gone missing! Explore the gallery and search through the cabinets, display stands, and other locations for Chaosified artworks and place them in the <color=#F0C777>Restorer</color> to repair them, all within the <color=#F0C777>time limit</color>.

There are <color=#F0C777>3 Art Trackers</color> in the area lying in disrepair. Once repaired, they automatically boost your progress. Protect them from Chaos attacks!
<color=#F0C777>Splitting up into groups to search different zones</color> can greatly improve efficiency.
The harbor is under attack! Find the explosives on-site within the <color=#F0C777>allotted time</color>, disrupt the Chaos assault, and prevent the explosion.

<color=#F0C777>Splitting up into groups to search different zones</color> can greatly improve efficiency. Work together to dismantle all <color=#F0C777>explosive devices</color> to complete the event.

The metro construction site is under attack! Defend the position around the <color=#F0C777>drilling rig</color> and repel the Chaos onslaught intend on destroying it.
Protect the rig until it <color=#F0C777>completes its operation</color> to earn rewards.
Enemies attack in <color=#F0C777>waves</color> and come from all directions. Coordinating with other players is key.

Work with up to <color=#F0C777>3</color> other players and venture deep into the Spiko Hotel for cooperative missions.
Your team must choose 1 of <color=#F0C777>3 methods</color> as your course of action, after which you complete preparatory tasks to collect key items.

Completing preparatory tasks grants corresponding key items. Collect all key items to unlock the final plan for your chosen route and earn generous rewards upon completion. 
Each method offers a <color=#F0C777>completely different experience</color>. <color=#F0C777>Rewards</color> are distributed based on each player’s contribution to procuring key items. This game mode is <color=#F0C777>replayable</color>.

records.Desc: 当鱼类发起进攻并通过QTE操作成功刺鱼后将进入收线博弈阶段，这是钓鱼过程中最紧张刺激的部分。玩家需要持续按住收线键来拉近鱼的距离，但必须时刻关注屏幕上的张力条显示。当张力条进入红色危险区域时，说明鱼正在剧烈挣扎，此时应该松开收线键或改为轻点收线，避免鱼线绷断。

records.Desc: Each type of Scratch-Off operates differently. Scratch the ticket to reveal symbols. If the symbols that appear match the designated winners, you win the corresponding prize.
Scratch the ticket. If a “Horse” symbol appears, you win the amount shown beneath it. All prizes stack. Each Scratch-Off has 8 chances to win.

Scratch the ticket. If you reveal 3 identical numbers in the same round, you win that round’s prize. If all three numbers are “8”, you win 8 times that round’s prize. Each Scratch-Off has 8 rounds in total.
